purpose: Diagnostic independent examination of held source bytes and complete operative source content; no scientific status adoption or canonical filing

method.source_scope: Only seven source-card PDFs; complete listed relevant pages and their visible neighbors, footnotes and embedded convention material
method.extraction: pdftotext -layout for navigation/transcription; visual pages control quotations and boundaries
method.quotation_convention: Visual-source transcription; whitespace and line-break hyphenation normalized; list items may be joined with spaces. Case is normalized only in titles. No OCR offsets or machine inventory used.
method.not_examined: Unlisted issue pages are not certified as visually examined; full target instruments, underlying statutes, full convention and later lifecycle sources not examined.
method.instruction_handling: Read AGENTS.md, HANDOFF/KEAN.md, HANDOFF/README.md and claim-kit protocol. Deferred latest HANDOFF notes to prevent potential source-audit leakage until seal. Coordinator owns shared register/HANDOFF integration.

elapsed_timing.scope: Measured lower bound covering extraction/rendering, visual review and write-up; earlier instruction/source-card reading not included; exact total agent elapsed not instrumented

method.tools: exec_command, write_stdin, pdftoppm, pdftotext, pdfinfo, sha256 through Python hashlib, view_image; collaboration messages
method.tokens: Unavailable: no reliable runtime usage telemetry exposed

legal_boundaries: No legal status, lifecycle ending or exhaustion is adopted. Conventional classification of provisions is diagnostic. Treaty independent force, source oddities, target-amendment consequences and current statutory predicate need source-complete legal review where noted.

command_inventory.location: printed p1995, left-column bottom through middle-column top
command_inventory.quote: Executive Order No. 5341, of May 2, 1930, withdrawing public lands in Arizona pending a resurvey, and heretofore partially revoked, is hereby revoked as to the remainder of the lands affected thereby.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Revocation of the remaining geographic coverage of EO5341; prior partial revocations are acknowledged, not redone.

command_inventory.quote: This order shall become effective upon the date of the official filing of the plat of the resurvey of the lands involved.

Cannot infer that the contingent command became effective, was executed, or ended from this source alone.

cases.title: Extending the Provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act to Certain Federal Employees, and Amending Civil Service Rule II
cases.visual_tool: view_image, full page images, all listed pages
cases.source_boundary: PDF p1: EO begins in left column, continues at top of middle column, and ends [No.8083], FR Doc39-1214. The April5,1939 trade-agreements letter beginning below is a different instrument.

command_inventory.quote: The provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930 (46 Stat. 470), are hereby extended to apply (1) to all Federal employees who have been or may be appointed to any position named in Schedule A or Schedule B of the Civil Service Rules, or to any position excepted by law or Executive order from the operation of the Civil Service Act and Rules, provided that such employees have been or shall be appointed pursuant to the provisions of subdivision (d) of section 3 of Civil Service Rule II, and (2) to all employees who have been or may be accorded a classified status while serving in such positions.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Two eligible classes under one retirement-coverage extension. Both retrospective and prospective phrasing must remain; this is not a single named-person act.

command_inventory.quote: Subdivision (d) of section 3 of Civil Service Rule II is hereby amended to read as follows:
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Replacement amendment; the full following quotation is part of the operative content.

command_inventory.location: printed p1577, left column, replacement text
command_inventory.quote: The proper appointing officer may fill any position named in Schedule A or Schedule B, or any other excepted position, as classified positions are filled, in which case the person so appointed shall be eligible for transfer, reinstatement, or promotion to positions in the classified service, subject to the provisions of these rules.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Permission to appoint and resulting eligibility, expressly subject to the rules; retained substantive replacement rule.

command_inventory.location: printed p1577, left column, replacement text
command_inventory.quote: The incumbent of any excepted position so filled will not be entitled to protection against removal afforded by these rules.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Distinct limitation on removal protection within the replacement rule; cannot omit as mere background.

command_inventory.quote: Executive Order No. 3375 of December 24, 1920, extending the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 22, 1920, to certain Federal employees, is hereby superseded.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Express supersession separate from retirement extension and replacement of RuleII.

command_inventory.quote: This order shall become effective on May 1, 1939.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Express effective date applies to this order as a whole.

qualifications_and_ambiguities: Authority recital cites retirement-act section3, Revised Statutes section1753, Civil Service Act1883. Commission recommendation is explanatory, not another command.
Footnote 1 at Civil Service Rule II: "3 F.R. 1519 DI." It is reference context, not order number or extra rule text.
Printed replacement appears "incumbent"; OCR produces "encumbent". Quotes transcribe the visual source with normalized whitespace and removed line-break hyphens.
No later ending or current predicate established. Cannot treat the act of amending/superseding alone as exhausting the continuing coverage/eligibility content.

cases.title: Establishing the Lake Moraine Migratory Waterfowl Refuge — North Dakota
cases.visual_tool: view_image, full page images, all listed pages
cases.source_boundary: PDF p4, right column: begins after EO8122 signature/doc block, ends [No.8123], FR Doc39-1606. EO8124 Lake Oliver begins below. The Florence/Half-Way/Hutchinson/Johnson refuge text in other columns belongs to neighboring orders.

command_inventory.quote: it is ordered that all lands within or controlled by the United States within the following-described area, comprising 320.00 acres, more or less, in Burleigh County, North Dakota, be, and they are hereby, reserved and set apart, subject to valid rights, for the use of the Department of Agriculture as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife:
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Reservation/use directive with express valid-rights qualification; geographic description is part of the coverage.

command_inventory.location: printed p1996, right column, Fifth Principal Meridian
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Land coverage. Visual source says "all lands within or controlled by the United States"; preserve the unusual "within" wording rather than silently replacing with neighbors' "owned".

command_inventory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to pursue, hunt, trap, capture, wilfully disturb, or kill any bird or wild animal of any kind whatsoever within the limits of the refuge, or to enter thereon, except under such rules and regulations as may be prescribed by the Secretary of Agriculture.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Distinct prohibition on wildlife acts and entry; delegated regulatory exception is part of the provision.

command_inventory.quote: This reservation shall be known as the Lake Moraine Migratory Waterfowl Refuge.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Separate naming direction, with continuing referential effect; not evidence of the legal fate of the reservation.

qualifications_and_ambiguities: No own footnotes, schedule, attachment or express termination date. No later event established by the original.
The reservation, conduct prohibition/regulatory exception, and naming provision should all be accounted for; grouping into one inventory unit is possible only with complete substantive coverage.
Source phrasing "within or controlled" is awkward and legal effect of that precise wording is not resolved by this examination.

cases.title: Correcting Executive Orders Nos. 8680, 8682, and 8683 of February 14, 1941, Establishing Certain Naval Defensive Sea Areas and Naval Airspace Reservations
cases.visual_tool: view_image, full page images, all listed pages
cases.source_boundary: PDF p1: starts at bottom middle column after Proclamation2471. Continues at top middle column of PDF p2; ends [No.8729], FR Doc41-2468. EO8730 Civil Service amendment begins immediately below. Footnotes1/2 at foot of p2 middle column attach to target-order citations; footnote3 there concerns later military rule.

command_inventory.quote: The phrase “the territorial waters between the extreme high-water marks in the three-mile marine boundaries” occurring in the first paragraph of Executive Orders Nos. 8680, 8682, and 8683 of February 14, 1941, establishing certain naval defensive sea areas and naval airspace reservations, is hereby corrected to read “the territorial waters between the extreme high-water marks and the three-mile marine boundaries”.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Single correction sentence reaching the first paragraph of each of three named targets; replaces "in" with "and". Targets and exact replacement belong in substantive scope.

qualifications_and_ambiguities: Quotation spans PDF pp1–2, not p1 alone. No new standalone sea-area reservation, later termination, or independent continuing command is expressly created outside corrected target language here.
Footnote1 to EO8680: "6 F.R. 1014." Footnote2 to EO8682 and EO8683: "6 F.R. 1015." These are citations, not text imported from target orders.
The full target orders are not supplied as relevant pages in these source cards; legal implications of correction for target coverage and later lifecycle require additional material.
No own express effective date beyond signature; do not infer retrospective operation solely from label "corrected".

cases.title: Establishing a National Indian Institute in the Department of the Interior
cases.visual_tool: view_image, full page images, all listed pages
cases.source_boundary: PDF p1: starts left column at EO heading; recitals include Convention Article X text. Section1 begins bottom left and continues top middle, followed by sections2–3. Section3 continues at top middle of PDF p2, followed sections4–6 and [No.8930], FR Doc41-8262. EO8931 Panama Canal begins below and continues right; CCC rules are unrelated.

command_inventory.location: printed p5613, left column, Convention Article X quoted paragraph1
command_inventory.quote: The nations subscribing to this Convention shall, on such date as they may deem advisable and within their respective jurisdictions, organize National Indian Institutes. The functions of said Institutes shall, by and large, consist in stimulating interest in and furnishing information about Indian matters to any persons and to public and private institutions. Such National Institutes shall further carry out any studies on these questions that may be of particular interest to the nation concerned.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Quoted convention context includes timing discretion, functions, and study language. Not to be mistaken for numbered sections of the EO or silently discarded from source review.

command_inventory.location: printed p5613, left column, Convention Article X quoted paragraph2
command_inventory.quote: National Indian Institutes shall be affiliated to the Inter-American Indian Institute, to which they shall submit an annual report.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Treaty/convention recital of affiliation/reporting; EO sections1 and2(g) separately implement these matters.

command_inventory.location: printed p5613, left column, Convention Article X quoted paragraph3
command_inventory.quote: The financing, organization and regulations of said National Indian Institutes shall be matters falling exclusively within the purview of the respective Governments;
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Domestic-government financing/organization/regulations qualification; not an EO appropriation.

command_inventory.quote: There is hereby established in the Department of the Interior a National Indian Institute for the United States of America, which Institute shall be affiliated with the Inter-American Indian Institute.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Establish institution and direct affiliation; two operative components, not merely a one-time establishment caption.

command_inventory.quote: Initiate and promote collaboration in the fields of Indian administration and the study of the Indian among Federal, State and private agencies, learned societies, and scholars in the United States, and the Inter-American Indian Institute, and through the Institute with governmental agencies, learned societies and scholars in the other American countries.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Institute shall perform this collaboration function.

command_inventory.quote: Collaborate with the Inter-American Indian Institute, learned societies, and foundations in the coordination, development, and administration of research projects and studies relating to the Indian.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Separate required research-collaboration function.

command_inventory.quote: Maintain liaison between agencies of the United States Government directly or indirectly concerned with Indian administration or Indian studies in this or other countries for the purpose of coordinating cooperation by the United States with other American nations in regard to Indian matters.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Separate liaison/coordination function.

command_inventory.quote: Direct the preparation and publication of materials dealing with Indian administration in the United States of interest to the other American nations, and to publish such other materials as may be required in connection with authorized activities.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Publication preparation/direction and publishing function, with authorized-activities qualifier.

command_inventory.quote: Assemble and prepare library material and bibliographies dealing with Indian problems.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Library/bibliography function.

command_inventory.quote: Collaborate with the Inter-American Indian Institute in planning for the Inter-American Conference on Indian Life.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Conference-planning collaboration; source does not establish the conference occurred or all planning ceased.

command_inventory.quote: Submit an annual report to the Inter-American Indian Institute.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Recurring annual report, not a date that terminates the institution or all functions.

command_inventory.quote: The Institute shall be managed by a Director who, with other necessary employees, shall be appointed by the Secretary of the Interior, and its functions shall be administered in the Bureau of Indian Affairs.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Management, appointment authority/duty, and BIA administration are distinct components.

command_inventory.location: printed pp5613–5614, middle-column cross-page continuation of section3
command_inventory.quote: The Institute shall use insofar as practicable such informational, fiscal, personnel, and other general business services and facilities as may be made available through the Interior Department or other agencies of the Government.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Service/facility-use duty qualified by practicability and availability. Continuation on p2 must remain.

command_inventory.quote: There is hereby established a Policy Board of the Institute which shall recommend policies to be followed by the Institute, and which shall be composed of:
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Establishment plus continuing recommendation and composition provisions; the following six items are part of scope.

command_inventory.quote: The Commissioner of Indian Affairs.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Ex officio composition requirement.

command_inventory.quote: Two or more members, who may be public officers or private citizens, to be appointed by the Secretary of the Interior, at least one of whom shall be an Indian.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Minimum number, appointment authority and at-least-one-Indian condition.

command_inventory.quote: One representative designated by the Secretary of State.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Required representative/designator.

command_inventory.quote: One representative designated by the Secretary of Agriculture.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Required representative/designator.

command_inventory.quote: One representative designated by the Smithsonian Institution.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Required representative/designator.

command_inventory.quote: One representative designated by the Librarian of Congress.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Required representative/designator.

command_inventory.quote: In addition to the foregoing, one representative may be designated as a member of the Board by each of the following organizations: The National Research Council. The Social Science Research Council. The American Council of Learned Societies.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Optional representation by each named organization; permission differs from mandatory core composition.

command_inventory.quote: The Chairman of the Board, who shall be designated by the Secretary of the Interior, shall call meetings of the Board, and, subject to the approval of the Board, may establish advisory committees and may designate, as affiliates of the Institute, learned societies and other organizations concerned with the study of the Indian and with Indian welfare.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Chair designation, duty to call meetings, and Board-approval-qualified permissions for committees/affiliates all retained.

command_inventory.quote: The members of the Board and the advisory committees may be reimbursed for necessary traveling expenses and subsistence, as provided by law.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Reimbursement permission limited by necessity, categories, and law; independent substantive provision.

qualifications_and_ambiguities: Recitals state Senate advice/consentMay26,1941, convention openedMexicoCityNovember1,1940, USsignedNovember29,1940, PresidentratifiedJune6,1941. These historical recitals are not later execution evidence for EO duties.
Another recital states DOI charged by law with supervision/management of all Indian affairs. It provides authority/context and is not itself a new order to assume every Indian-affairs function.

No separate attachment or full convention is appended on the two relevant pages; only ArticleX is quoted. This examination does not decide treaty independent legal force or all convention obligations without full treaty context.

No own footnotes or express sunset. Creation, affiliation, seven section2 functions, management/appointments/BIA administration, service use, policy board/composition, chair/meetings/committees/affiliates, and reimbursement all need substantive accounting.
No conclusion that any command was discharged or terminated follows merely from establishment, historical annual reports, reorganization or passage of time; later evidence not examined.

cases.title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Commerce
cases.visual_tool: view_image, full page images, all listed pages
cases.source_boundary: Two-page order-specific PDF. PDF p1 contains authority recital and sections1–3; PDF p2 contains section4, signature/date, FR Doc2012-12882. No neighboring instrument text or annex within supplied PDF.

command_inventory.quote: Subject to the provisions of section 2 of this order, and to the limitations set forth in the Act, the following officials of the Department of Commerce, in the order listed, shall act as and perform the functions and duties of the office of the Secretary of Commerce (Secretary) during any period in which the Secretary has died, resigned, or otherwise become unable to perform the functions and duties of the office of the Secretary:
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Conditional ordered succession duty, expressly subject to exceptions and FVRA; all nine ranked offices are material.

command_inventory.quote: (a) Deputy Secretary of Commerce; (b) General Counsel of the Department of Commerce; (c) Under Secretary of Commerce for International Trade; (d) Under Secretary of Commerce for Economic Affairs; (e) Under Secretary of Commerce for Standards and Technology; (f) Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere and Administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; (g) Under Secretary of Commerce for Export Administration; (h) Chief Financial Officer of the Department of Commerce and Assistant Secretary of Commerce (Administration); and (i) The Boulder Laboratories Site Manager, National Institute of Standards and Technology.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Ranked offices; nine subitems are a hierarchy within the succession provision, not nine separate unrelated directives.

command_inventory.quote: No individual who is serving in an office listed in section 1(a)–(i) of this order in an acting capacity shall, by virtue of so serving, act as Secretary pursuant to this order.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Exclusion of acting occupants by virtue of acting status.

command_inventory.quote: No individual listed in section 1(a)–(i) of this order shall act as Secretary unless that individual is otherwise eligible to so serve under the Act, as amended.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Statutory eligibility condition distinct from acting-occupant exclusion.

command_inventory.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of this order, the President retains discretion, to the extent permitted by law, to depart from this order in designating an acting Secretary.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Express retained presidential discretion within legal limits.

command_inventory.quote: Executive Order 13242 of December 18, 2001 (Providing An Order of Succession Within the Department of Commerce) and Memorandum for the Secretary of Commerce of October 3, 2002 (Designation of Officers of the Department of Commerce to Act as Secretary of Commerce) are hereby revoked.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Express revocation of both a numbered EO and unnumbered dated memorandum.

command_inventory.quote: This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.
command_inventory.source_first_reading: Judicial-review/noncreation limitation is substantive source context; retained separately even if not an affirmative duty.

qualifications_and_ambiguities: Authority recital includes FVRA1998 as amended5USC3345etseq. It incorporates statutory limitations; the underlying statute is not independently examined in this source-card-only phase.
No separate general-provisions section, implementation/funding command, effective-date paragraph, or attachment appears. Section4 is on second page and must not disappear from complete inventory.
No later revocation/current predicate search was performed. Source-only reading cannot establish status at2026-10-14.
